Review Title: The restrictions of netflix
Review Text:
I really enjoy the variety of content Netflix offers, and it's one of my favourite streaming services. However, I frequently encounter a significant issue when travelling internationally.
Whenever I visit another country, the available subtitles automatically switch to the local language, and there is no option to change them back to English. This makes it impossible for me to watch non-English content, such as anime and Southeast Asian dramas, because English subtitles are no longer available.
Unfortunately, using a VPN is not a solution, as Netflix detects it and prevents playback until it is turned off.
I believe Netflix should allow users to choose subtitle languages based on their personal preferences rather than their current location. I think it would greatly improve the experience using this app that I pay for.

At the moment, this limitation prevents me from watching many of my favourite shows while travelling, which significantly reduces the value of my subscription during those periods. I hope Netflix will consider introducing a global subtitle preference, as I believe it would greatly benefit many users.

Review Title: Netflix is one of the most popular…
Review Text:
Netflix is one of the most popular streaming services and offering a wide variety of movies, TV shows, documentaries, and original series. It has something for almost everyone, which is one reason it became so successful. The platform is easy to use, works well on TVs, phones, tablets, and computers, and provides personalized recommendations based on what viewers watch. At first, Netflix leaves a good impression because finding content is simple to use and the streaming quality is usually reliable with a stable internet connection.
Although Netflix has many positive features, many viewers feel the service has changed over the years, and not necessarily for the better. One of the biggest frustrations is spending more time scrolling through titles than actually finding something worth watching. While Netflix continues to release original movies and series, not all of them are enjoyable, and many popular shows seem to get canceled just when viewers become invested in the story. This can leave subscribers feeling disappointed after spending time following a series that never gets a proper ending.
Another downside is the price. Subscription costs have continued to increase, making many subscribers question whether the service is still worth the money. At the same time, several popular movies and television shows have been removed from the platform, giving viewers fewer familiar options to choose from. The password-sharing restrictions also frustrated many longtime subscribers who were used to sharing accounts with close family members. While Netflix still offers convenience and has a few great original shows, many viewers feel other streaming services give them more for what they're paying.
Overall, Netflix receives 2 out of 5 stars in this review. The platform is easy to navigate and still offers quality streaming, but the rising subscription costs, changing content library, and frequent cancellation of popular shows make it difficult to recommend. Netflix may still be a good option for people who enjoy binge-watching original series and don’t mind the possibility of not getting an ending, However, anyone looking for the best value and a larger variety of movies and shows may be happier with another streaming service.

The second person was even more ignorant than the first one and sounded like a bot who did not know anything about anything, but could feel my frustration and would take on board my feedback! What feedback?

With staff, which are the face of Netflix, like these, I can only conclude Netflix will sink faster than the titanic.
